name: io.github.tonyyang0504/tiktok_creator_marketplace-mcp
description: TikTok One (Creator Marketplace) (ads): me, list_campaigns. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_CREATOR_MARKETPLACE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Access token authorized by a TikTok One Creator Marketplace account (auth_code exchanged at /oauth2/access_token/); it does not expire unless the account revokes it (https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_CREATOR_MARKETPLACE_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Secret of your TikTok for Business developer app, needed by the account-listing call used by me.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_CREATOR_MARKETPLACE_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: App ID of your TikTok for Business developer app (My Apps > App Detail > Basic Information).
